name: sled 45 degrees leg press
description: A leg press on a 45 degree sled that loads the thighs and hips while your back stays supported.
instructions: Sit in the seat with your back and head flat against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the pad as you descend.
Push through your whole foot to extend your legs without locking your knees.
